candidate_identity.source: GitHub Actions GITHUB_SHA / checked-out git rev-parse HEAD
candidate_identity.rule: The detached candidate manifest must record the exact current HEAD and may only be generated from a clean frozen scope.
candidate_identity.materialized_manifest: V2 CI artifact: v2-rc5-candidate-<full commit SHA>/V2.0.0-rc.5.manifest.json

deployment_rule: Build dist once, materialize and verify its detached manifest, then upload that exact dist directory without rebuilding.
approval_boundary: V2-N4 remains USER_REVIEW; this control file must remain pending_v2_n4 until an explicit USER approval commit.
